also passed. Retained framework composition checks still failed: Chrome, Edge
and Firefox lost an injected composing range; Safari passed its Prompt and
numeric scenarios but lost the composing range during synthetic resize. These
results do not establish OS IME acceptance.

Android's full original journey now observes its asynchronous copy feedback and
passes. The iOS result differs from [bff08825](./bff08825-ci.md): this time its
VM log query succeeded with 227 bytes, `host_group_clean=true`, and a completed

application assertion failure requiring its own diagnosis, not an external
discovery failure or an accepted iOS journey.

The native bridge probe's complete `report.json` now parses directly as JSON.
All three real FlView cases and weak-reference finalization checks passed;

entry. The [Linux SDK boundary report](../../docs/beautiful-ui/quality_evidence/2026-09-04-linux-sdk-accessibility-boundaries.md)
